title: "Julia Test Including The Same Sim Twice But Freezing"
engine: julia
---




Testing if using the option `freeze: true` works...

The settings in the `.qmd` file of the simulation are: 

```yaml
---
title: "Demo of a Julia Notebook With a Random Simulation"
engine: julia
execute:
    freeze: true
---
```

    1:nSim, sim
)
ax.title = "Picking $nSim Number With Replacement From 1 to 5"

fig
